verdict.rationale: Cognee documents an official Python API with a coherent memory surface: remember, recall, improve, forget and session memory (python-api.md and the main-operations docs). A Docker-hosted HTTP service on port 8000 offers another integration path. However, nothing in the evidence shows an official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK, so cross-language API equivalence is unsupported. Missing for 10: official TypeScript SDK, evidence of equivalent memory APIs across Python and TypeScript, published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), independent corroboration of SDK usage.
